question: If Dark Depths leaves the battlefield before its triggered ability resolves, do I still create Marit Lage?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you can't sacrifice Dark Depths, so you won't create Marit Lage.
expected.answer: If Dark Depths leaves the battlefield before its triggered ability resolves, you won't be able to sacrifice it, so you won't create Marit Lage.
